Discussion only · nothing is being built from this page

Ejam kopā: the new look

Round nine. The page is rebuilt around what you have agreed. It opens with the agreed rules, one line per element, then follows the way a person meets the site: the identity, the header and navigation, discovery, search, a group, an event, your own area, pop-ups, admin. Each element is drawn in full in one place; everywhere else it appears exactly the same, or the text points to it. Your answers of 12 October are applied everywhere: one "Sazināties" button, one filter row with the Grupas / Pasākumi switch at its right end, two-line group rows on phones, one place list with "Visur", a shorter profile menu and one phone header.

New in 9.2: your answers of 13 October (the redesign ships in parts; the language switch stays in the header; screens not drawn follow the rules; the event's place, faces, withdrawing a request, no "Mani pasākumi", social links), four screens drawn from the rules (the event page, Biedri, a group's Jaunumi, Mans profils), questions 4 and 8 redone as pictures, and near the end, everything from comparing this page with the live site. 9.3 (after a review): Still open is down to 18 real questions; what the Handbook or this page already decides is answered in the comparison instead.

Still open

Only real questions. Each has the default I would build if you say nothing. Questions 1–7 are from round nine (7 now also covers reporting an event); 8–18 came from comparing this page with the live site (Compared with the live app). Your answers of 13 October are in the Agreed rules.

  1. The compact filter area: stay with A?

    On 12 October you chose one row (A). Your earlier note asked what other sites do, so B and C are drawn too (Discovery → "More compact"). Default: A, as you decided.

  2. The bottom bar: where "Grupas" and "Es" lead, and which tab a group page marks

    Default: "Grupas" opens Manas grupas, "Es" opens Mans profils; on a group page the tab you came from stays marked (Atklāt from discovery, Grupas from Manas grupas), as phone apps do.

  3. Where does Iestatījumi live?

    The profile menu links to it, and light/dark is there. Default: the fifth page of your own area, last in its menu, like a group's Iestatījumi.

  4. The end of the group list

    Events end with "Rādīt nākamo nedēļu"; groups have no rule. Default: 24 cards, then "Rādīt vēl", no endless scrolling (Handbook: calm, not sticky).

  5. The place for someone we don't know

    Signed out, we know nothing. Default: start on "Visur" and ask "Kur tu esi?" once, above the results; keep the answer on the device; never guess from the internet address. Signed in: the profile city.

  6. When is a notification read?

    You said you would decide later. Default: when you tap it, as today.

  7. Reporting people and events

    Today only groups can be reported. Default: later, both together, as a second tab in Moderācija → Sūdzības; until then "Ziņot par grupu" in the group's "…" menu.

  8. Events you can't simply join: how do they look?

    Default: one quiet word on the row ("Pieteikšanās" or "Pilns"), a button that names the step, and the outlined "Gaida" tag after you ask. Some events need the organiser's approval, some are full and have a waiting list. Pictures: An event → Events you can't simply join.

  9. Waiting join requests for the group team

    Default: no separate section; "2 pieteikumi" on that group's row in Tavas grupas, and a tap opens Biedri → Pieteikumi. Today Manas grupas starts with a "Jārīkojas" list: the groups you help run where someone waits for an answer. Pictures: Your own area → Waiting join requests.

  10. Where do you change your profile?

    Today "Labot profilu" is a page of its own; Mans profils is new. Default: "Labot profilu" on Mans profils opens the form in place (name, picture, about you, places, the three privacy switches); Iestatījumi keeps Izskats, and later your account.

  11. Private groups

    Today a group can be private (the create form says "Privāta", settings say "Tikai biedriem"): it is left out of discovery and search, and people join by invitation or approval. The page never shows one. Default: keep that, with one word everywhere, "Tikai biedriem"; someone with the link sees Informācija and "Sazināties" like any visitor, and the quiet line under the name ends with "Tikai biedriem".

  12. The full word behind "Mod"

    Today the role reads "Grupas moderators". Default: the tag stays "Mod"; lists and menus say "Moderators"; "grupas komanda" means the owner and the moderators together, as in the Handbook.

  13. Members-only events, seen by members

    Visitors don't see them (agreed). Default: members see them like any event; "Tikai biedriem" is a quiet line in the panel and on the event page, not on the row. Someone who follows a link without being a member gets one sentence and "Sazināties".

  14. How a member writes to the group's team

    Today from the "all members" pop-up on Informācija, which goes. Default: "Rakstīt komandai" in the group's "…" menu (drawn in A group); it opens the same conversation as "Sazināties".

  15. Asking "are you sure?" for steps that can be undone

    Deleting for good already has its rule (the Handbook: our own dialog in the middle, naming the thing; never the browser's box). Open are the smaller steps that can be undone, which today use the browser's box or a dialog. Default: a small pop-over at the button for leaving a group and removing a member.

  16. Deleting your account

    It doesn't exist today, and the page doesn't mention it. Default: "Dzēst kontu" at the end of Iestatījumi, with a dialog; built before real people use the site.

  17. "Ko meklējam?" in one language or two

    Default: one short text, as the team writes it, not one per language (a group's longer texts keep their LV | EN versions, as today).

  18. The four new drawings

    The event page, Biedri, a group's Jaunumi and Mans profils were drawn on 13 October from the rules (marked Proposal). Default: build them as drawn; small details are reviewed on the test site.

The profile menu has four lines. "Manas grupas" counts what is new in your groups since you last looked. Ziņas and Paziņojumi are not repeated here: they have their own icons in the header, and their full pages are in your own area. Light and dark live only in Iestatījumi.

The navigation rule Agreed

  1. Two levels: an area's pages (a group's pages, your own area's pages, admin's sections) and a page's parts (Par mums · Kā notiek pirmā tikšanās · Praktiski; Gaidāmie · Pagājušie; admin's pages). A page with parts of its own in admin (Dizains, Rokasgrāmata) opens them indented in the same list, never as a third menu.
  2. One level runs across, the other down. Never two rows across, stacked, and never two lists down, side by side.
  3. Groups and your own area: pages down the left, parts across as tabs. Admin: five sections across the top (sticky), their pages down the left.
  4. Phones: the pages go into a drawer from the left, opened by ☰ in the bar; the parts stay as tabs. Admin's many pages sit in the same drawer, under their section.
  5. No repeated labels: the chosen item already says where you are. On phones, where the menu is in the drawer, the page's name stands over its tabs.

Drawn in full: a group in A group, your own area in Your own area, admin in Admin.

"Ko meklējam?" is an optional group field of up to 60 characters, written by the team ("Meklējam bundzinieku"). When it is empty, the card shows the next meeting with a small calendar icon, so the two kinds of note are told apart. The photo takes about a fifth of the card, at most 84 px; the name gets two lines. The row has no photo and no note: the name (up to two lines), one quiet line, and the category's colour and icon on the right, where the card has its photo. The quiet line stays one line: on a narrow phone the sub-categories are cut short first ("…"), so the city and the member count, which matter most, always show (Handbook: "Find your people at a glance"). The name may take two lines.

The day stripOpen

Your idea, drawn: the month and "Šodien" on top, seven days below, the chosen day filled in Sūna, today outlined, a small dot on days with events; days without events are greyed. A tap jumps the list to that day; a swipe (the arrows on desktop) moves a week. It sits under the filter row and scrolls away with the list. The dot is the site colour, because a day mixes categories. Not reviewed yet.

The date pickerOpen

The calendar button opens the quick choices and a month (drawn above under "The drop-downs, open"). One tap picks a day, a second tap a range; the button says how many events that gives ("Rādīt 23"). The range then reads on the row ("15.–18. okt.") and in the chosen line with its ×. On phones the date button opens the same thing as a sheet. Not reviewed yet.

More compact: three options from other sites Open

Your note: the header and filters still take too much room; look at what other sites do. I looked at Meetup, Airbnb, Booking, Google's Material filter chips, SAP's filter bar and Baymard's filter research. Three ways that fit us, recommended first. All three use the parts above; only the arrangement changes. Before the first card, round eight used about 190 px on desktop (header, tabs, filters, "Izvēlēts").

SazinātiesAtvērt grupas lapu

Inside: the photo with ×, the name, category and sub-categories, city · members, the next meeting, the short text, then "Sazināties" and "Atvērt grupas lapu" for anyone who wants to read more. "Sazināties" opens the form below on top of the panel, so nobody has to load another page first.

One button: "Sazināties" Agreed

Your decision of 12 October: wherever a group can be reached (the opened card, the group header, the phone group bar), there is one button, "Sazināties". Its form has a switch, "Vēlos pievienoties grupai". While the group takes new members the switch is on, so the same short message also asks to join, and the form's title says so ("Pieteikties grupā …"); switched off, it is only a message ("Sazināties ar grupu …"). When the group takes no new members, the switch isn't there. There is no separate join button.

The live site today already has this form, with the switch, the changing title and the same texts. Three things differ and change with the redesign: the group header's button still reads "Pieteikties" while a group takes members (it will always read "Sazināties"); after asking, it shows "Pieprasīts" with a × to cancel (it will show "Pieteikums nosūtīts" and "Atvērt sarunu", as the Handbook says); and the send button reads "Sūtīt pieprasījumu" or "Sūtīt ziņu" (it will read "Nosūtīt": buttons name the result).

Events away from home Agreed

A group lives in one city, but a dance group performs in Liepāja and a hiking group walks in Sigulda. So an event has its own place, and every list filters by the event's place, not the group's. The place is a city from the list (required, filled in with the group's city to start) plus a free address; an online event gets "Tiešsaistē" and shows under "Visur" (13 October). The Jelgava dancers' concert shows up under Liepāja; the row names Liepāja, and the panel says who organises it and where they are from.

Dizains has three parts. Krāsas: the site colour (Sūna to start) and the neutral background, lines and quiet text that go with it, light and dark; more themes can be added here later. Kategoriju krāsas: one row per category, its light and dark tone, and "AA ✓" or a short warning when a tone fails. Fonti: Literata and Commissioner, each with a Latvian sample, chosen from a short checked list so every option has all the Latvian letters. You preview a change yourself first, then publish it for everyone.

Salīdzinājums ar dzīvo lapu · Compared with the live app

On 13 October every screen of the live site was compared with this page, by reading the code on main. Below is everything that came out of it, not a summary: each live screen and where it is on this page; what the live site does that this page didn't mention, and what happens to it; where the two disagree, and whether that is an intended change, a mistake on this page, or still unclear; and what needs new data. Unclear points became questions in Still open (8–18), each with a default. File names are in small print, for the builders.

Your answers of 13 October

1 · One release? No: the redesign ships in logical parts, one by one (the build order below). Agreed rules → Identity
2 · Language and footer. The language switch is important: it stays visible in the header on every page, "LV ▾", built for more languages. A slim footer on discovery and reading pages. Header and navigation
3 · Screens not drawn. They follow the decisions on this page. The four most important are now drawn: the event page, Biedri, a group's Jaunumi, Mans profils (as proposals). Agreed rules
4 · Events that need approval or are full. Redone as pictures: An event → Events you can't simply join (Still open, 8).
5 · The event's place. A required city from the list, filled in with the group's city, plus a free address; "Tiešsaistē" for online events, shown under "Visur". An event
6 · Faces of who is going. Only for signed-in viewers; visitors see "12 iet". An event
7 · Withdrawing a request. "Atsaukt pieteikumu" in the group's "…" menu and on the Tavi pieteikumi row. A group, Your own area
8 · The team's "Jārīkojas". Redone as pictures: Your own area → Waiting join requests (Still open, 9).
9 · "Mani pasākumi" on a group. It goes. A group
10 · Social links and member faces. Links as quiet text at the end of Informācija; faces only on Biedri. A group

Every live screen (61)

61 screens and pop-ups: 22 drawn, 10 partly drawn, 8 only named in a menu, 16 not drawn, 5 new screens with no live counterpart. 12 rows changed in 9.2 (marked "· 9.2"). At the comparison (9.1) the numbers were 13 drawn, 12 partly, 12 named only, 19 not covered. A screen that isn't drawn follows the rules on this page (your answer of 13 October).

Build order: twelve parts, each released on its own Agreed 13 Oct

Your answer of 13 October: not one big release. Each part is built, reviewed and released before the next; the site works after every one. Identity comes first, because every later part is drawn in it.

  1. R1 · Identity

    The fonts, Sūna and its neutrals, the fifteen category tones (light and dark), shapes and words; Admin → Dizains with Krāsas, Kategoriju krāsas, Fonti, preview and publish (the deferred Session 15); the Handbook's Design chapter rewritten to the agreed rules. Released: today's screens in the new look, after an independent review. MigrationMaybe one (D3)

  2. R2 · Header, menus, footer

    The header with the language switch "LV ▾" and room for search, the profile and shield menus, the bottom bar without +, the slim footer, your own area's frame with Iestatījumi (Izskats, Kā ierīcē), the short messages and the grey loading shapes (the Handbook's Behaviour rules). Plan item 3.4.

  3. R3 · A group's frame

    The lower header, pages down the left (☰ on phones), tabs, one "Sazināties", the waiting state, the new words (C3–C5, C8), the "…" menu with your role, "Atsaukt pieteikumu", reporting, leaving, sharing. Plan items 2.22 and 3.2.

  4. R4 · Discovery data

    "Ko meklējam?" and the event's place (with the form fields), several cities, counts, dates, sub-categories for events, each group's next meeting (D1, D2, D7–D11). Released: the new fields in the forms; the lists keep working as today. An independent review before release: it changes the database. Migrationadd_group_looking_for, add_event_city

  5. R5 · Discovery

    The filter row, the place and sub-category lists, the drawer with counts and search, the group card and row, the create card, the chosen line, "Rādīt vēl", event rows by day a week at a time. The day strip and the calendar only after your review. Plan item 3.1.

  6. R6 · Panels

    The opened group and event panels with their own addresses, "Sazināties" and "Eju" from them, and the event cases (question 8) (D15).

  7. R7 · Search

    The header field with the place tag, category tags, recent searches; "Rādīt visus rezultātus" opens discovery, filtered. Plan item 3.5.

  8. R8 · Your own area

    Manas grupas (with question 9 answered), the Ziņas page in the frame, the Paziņojumi page, the "new" count (D4, D13, D14). Migrationadd_user_my_groups_seen_at

  9. R9 · A group's life

    The event page, the event form with its place, Biedri, Jaunumi, settings with "Ko meklējam?", Mans profils and someone else's profile. Plan items 3.3 (and 3.6 later).

  10. R10 · Citur Latvijā and the unknown place

    Distances between cities, the visitor's place kept on the device (D5, D16). Migrationadd_city_coordinates

  11. R11 · Admin frame

    Sections across, pages down the left, the phone drawer; the admin pages in the new look; the category-moving page stays reached from a group's site-admin tools.

  12. R12 · Everything else

    Sign in, register, choosing a username, the create-group wizard, Par mums, Privātums, page not found, the cookie banner.
